notes: No account, API key or runtime credential is required. The initial dependency installation downloads SDK packages; installed validation runs locally without network access.
Public preview metadata supplied by the maintainer; this is not independent TensorBlock verification or a production-readiness claim.
Requires Node.js 20 or later. Run installation and launch commands from the cloned repository root; an MCP host configuration must use the absolute path to the checkout's mcp/bin/server.mjs.
Install confidence is low because the source checkout requires manual replacement of the relative launch path with an absolute checkout path in the MCP host.
No client-specific compatibility or remote HTTP endpoint is claimed. The server does not authenticate supplied facts, select candidates, execute actions or grant downstream authority.
DeltaX Evaluate is optional and is not imported, called or required by this MCP server.
